seo_title: Frnds — pizzeria and coffee shop in Astana, Esil
seo_description: Pizza on dough we make ourselves, breakfast all day and specialty coffee. Astana, Sagadat Nurmagambetov 25. Open daily 09:00–23:00. Pickup via WhatsApp.
hero_logo_alt: Frnds — pizzeria and all-day breakfast in Astana
hero_text: We're at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street — we bake pizza on our own dough, pull coffee and fry eggs even at nine in the evening. Come by the way you'd come to a friend's place: no occasion, no booking.
breakfast_text: Breakfast runs from open to close, 09:00 to 23:00. Slept till three? No harm done — the syrniki and the eggs are still here. We'll make the coffee fresh to go with them.
about_text: Frnds comes from friends. We wanted a place you can walk into alone with a laptop, as two people at breakfast, or as a whole table over pizza, and nobody hurries you along. Inspired by Brooklyn, cooked in Astana.

reviews.text: We came in at eight in the evening and ordered breakfast — syrniki and fried eggs. Nobody even blinked. The coffee was great too.
reviews.author: Aigerim

reviews.text: The pizza is on their own dough — thin, with a proper crust. We pick one up almost every Friday and it has never let us down.
reviews.author: Dmitriy

reviews.text: I sit here half the day with my laptop and no one rushes me. Specialty coffee, lemonades in summer — and they always say hello like I'm one of theirs.
reviews.author: Madina

howto.title: Eat in
howto.text: Just walk in, no booking needed — and if you want a particular table, message us on WhatsApp.

howto.title: Pickup
howto.text: Send your order to WhatsApp, we'll put it together and text you the moment it's ready.

howto.title: Delivery apps
howto.text: We don't run our own delivery, but you can order us through the delivery services — their couriers bring it.
